law_model.L1_LEVEL_VS_RESOLUTION: Declared H.26x level capacity (repo HEVC ladder table) must cover the declared RESOLUTION+fps. HEVC map L90..L186, AVC map level 30/31/40/42. DV/AV1 forms are UNKNOWN by design of this model (documented), never PASS by default.
law_model.L0_MANIFEST_CODEC: settings.codec_full must equal the doctrinal manifest codec for the profile.
law_model.L2_MANIFEST_RESOLUTION: X-Stream-Resolution (emitted STREAM-INF claim) must equal the manifest resolution.
law_model.L3_MANIFEST_FPS: X-Stream-FPS must equal the manifest fps.
law_model.L4_MAIN10_FLOOR: Preferred video codec must be hvc1.2.* (Main10) or better; AVC allowed only as P5 failsafe.
law_model.L5_LADDER_HAS_MANIFEST_CODEC: prisma_lab_sync_v20.codec_ladder_per_profile must contain the manifest codec (P5: hvc1.2.4.L90.B0).
law_model.L6_INTERNAL_CODEC_AGREEMENT: codec_full / codec_string / X-Stream-Codecs / ladder[0] must name the same codec family+level.
law_model.L8_HEADER_COUNT_CLAIM: settings.headersCount must equal the measured size of headerOverrides.
law_model.L9_CHANNELS_MAP_ALIGNMENT: channels_map codec_rfc6381 per profile must agree with the lab_master codec for that profile.
law_model.L10_EXCEL_CANONICAL_MATCH: Every field mapped in EXCEL_PROFILES_EXTRACT (canonical branch 6_NIVEL_2_PROFILES, D-20) must equal the JSON value. Cited as hoja!celda.
law_model.L11_FPS_LEVEL_CAPACITY: D-15: the declared fps must be supported by the canonical codec level at the canonical resolution. 120fps without level capacity = FAIL.
